summary: Comprehensive both-stack testing of DAMKAR Mimika attendance app. Backend: 26 pytest tests covering auth (admin/operator/viewer), RBAC enforcement, teams/employees seeding (54 pegawai, 6 regu), dashboard/recap/calendar/day endpoints, roster+batch attendance, rolling integrity (history preservation), Excel/PDF export, backup (admin-only), audit log, and user CRUD. All 26 tests PASS. Frontend: Playwright flow across viewer-RBAC, admin dashboard, Input Absensi batch, Rekap Bulanan/Periode, Kalender, Data Pegawai, Manajemen Regu, User Management, Laporan & Export, Audit Log. All core flows work. Role guards enforced both via sidebar hiding and route redirect to /dashboard. Rolling integrity verified: historical attendance keeps original regu after re-assignment.

issues: Recharts prints warning 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' because chart container may render before layout settles. Non-blocking, chart still displays after re-measure.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Recharts container width warning by giving the chart wrapper explicit min-height or using <ResponsiveContainer minHeight> to avoid flash of width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint.

(Nice-to-have) Testid naming consistency: Laporan & Export page uses `lap-excel-btn`/`lap-pdf-btn`, while Rekap Bulanan uses `export-excel-btn`/`export-pdf-btn` and Rekap Periode uses `period-export-excel`/`period-export-pdf`. The request spec referenced `export-excel-btn`/`export-pdf-btn` globally; consider unifying.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1131 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, employees, attendance, recap, export, backup) for maintainability.

DELETE /api/users/{uid} does soft-deactivate (sets status=INACTIVE) but endpoint verb implies hard-delete. Consider renaming to POST /users/{uid}/deactivate or allow reactivation via PUT (already works via PUT setting status=ACTIVE).
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with credentials potentially enabled — ensure production uses explicit origin list via CORS_ORIGINS env var.
resolve_teams_for_date logic correctly keeps historical regu for past attendance (verified via rolling integrity test).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All endpoints exercised. For UI retest: use external URL from frontend/.env, clear localStorage before switching users (viewer->admin re-login must clear 'damkar_token'). Testid conventions: nav-{path}, login-email/password/submit, dashboard-date, input-date/team, select-all/deselect-all/batch-{STATUS}-btn, roster-row-{id}/roster-check-{id}, rekap-month/rekap-team, period-start/period-end/quick-{n}, tab-total/tab-breakdown, add-employee-btn, roll-btn, add-user-btn, backup-btn, export-excel-btn/export-pdf-btn (Rekap Bulanan), period-export-excel/period-export-pdf (Rekap Periode), lap-excel-btn/lap-pdf-btn (Laporan & Export page). Audit uses div rows with audit-row-{id} (not table rows).
